name: r2-e1-tc05-ef-small
author: solx-loop
description: For B <= 256, a hand-written tcgen05 kind::tf32 kernel runs 144 one-SM CTAs, one per 128-row W tile. Each uses one UMMA with N = B rounded up to 16, accumulating in TMEM over the full K, and loads W once through a TMA ring with an L2 evict_first cache hint. The hinted W lines replace each other, so the harness's dirty L2 lines are not written back during the timed run, and the S band plus B = 131-211 fall from 49-61 us to 42-51 us rented. Stages of 2-4 k-blocks (64-72 KB) beat 1-k-block stages b
